name: Demi
description:
Made with 100% Brazilian Virgin Remy human hair, she features deep espresso roots that blend into a rich chocolate brown base. Defined ribbons of amber and toasted caramel run through the lengths, with a soft copper undertone that gives the lighter pieces their warmth. Brighter caramel pieces frame the face, while deeper brunette sections between the highlights keep the color rich and dimensional.

All photos are taken in natural lighting. She arrives professionally colored and styled. Care for her as you would your natural hair, and touch her up after unboxing if needed.

All sales are final
features: Bleached Knots/HD Lace/ single knots / diamond lace
